description: Creates a contractor account and returns their widget token and embed tag, ready to install with get_install_snippet. No password and no card: the owner is emailed a link to choose a password. Leads from their website are kept until they add a card in the dashboard ($0 today, free for the trial). Only use it when the person you are helping owns the business or has asked you to set this up for them, with their real business email.

company_name.description: The business name, as homeowners know it.

owner_email.description: The owner's real email. They receive the set-password link and lead alerts here.

trade.description: What the business quotes: roofing, gutters, gutter_guards, siding, painting, roof_cleaning, pressure_washing, solar, paving, sealcoating, concrete, pavers, decks, fencing, landscaping, sod, turf, irrigation, pools, snow_removal, land_clearing.

website.description: The website the widget will go on, optional.
